boot._comment_waitStrategy: race = reveal as soon as EITHER the dataset load OR minDurationMs finishes (matches 'dataloader complete and/or 1s'). Use 'both' to require dataset load AND the minimum duration to have both elapsed before revealing.

flip._comment: Matches the existing 1s CSS transition on #magi-boot-container's transform (rotate 180deg -> 0deg) -- bump the CSS transition to match if you change this.

cameraZoom._comment: Interpolated in log-space (see animateZoomValue in CinematicManager.js) so it reads as a continuous fly-in rather than a jump -- the zoom value itself spans 9 orders of magnitude, so a *linear* blend (even eased) looks frozen for ~99% of the animation and then teleports. easeOutCubic gives a fast initial sweep that settles gently; easeOutExpo felt too abrupt layered on top of the already-exponential zoom.

panelExtend._comment: Delay/duration for the MAGI triad sliding out to the docked edge positions before the boot overlay is dismissed.
